_comment: TEMPLATE for a MANUAL human-authored record. Copy one JSON object onto a single line in interactions.jsonl, or pipe it to log_event.py --mode manual. Manual records have source='manual' to distinguish them from automatically captured (source='auto') hook events. VERIFICATION: default this to 'self-reported'; authorship by a human is NOT independent verification. Use 'verified' ONLY when independent evidence (a commit SHA, a passing test, a reviewed diff) is referenced in execution_evidence/evidence_refs. The writer only fills in 'verified' when this field is omitted, so keep it explicit. CORRECTIONS: to correct/reference a prior event, put its id in evidence_refs (e.g. 'evt-000115') AND restate it in notes (e.g. 'corrects evt-000115'); no new schema field is needed. Do NOT include secrets, tokens, or raw credentials.

decisions: <approval or go/no-go decision made by a human>
corrections: <where a human changed or rejected AI output>

notes: <optional; e.g. 'corrects evt-000007' (pair with the evt id in evidence_refs) or 'secret redacted'>
